overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures premium dehydrated reetha powder sourced directly from agro-networks in India. Advanced milling technology pulverizes raw soapnut shells into a consistent 100 mesh powder. Completely free from synthetic surfactants, artificial colors, and chemical preservatives, this botanical ingredient offers dependable quality. It provides formulators with an authentic foaming material suitable for diverse cosmetics and eco-friendly cleaning preparations.

Operating as an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain strict moisture control under 8.0 percent to prevent clumping. Our six-step process spans sourcing, cleaning, drying, grinding, inspection, and dispatch. We support international manufacturers, formulators, and distributors through bulk supply, custom packaging, and flexible OEM private labeling, supported by dedicated export documentation for seamless global logistics.
highlights: Milled to an ultra-fine 100 mesh format
Free from synthetic surfactants and artificial colors
Stable 24-month shelf life under cool storage
Processed through a strict 6-step manufacturing system

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Reetha Powder?
faqs.a: Our standard minimum order quantity is 5 kg, accommodating formulation trials as well as bulk commercial orders.

faqs.q: Are product samples available before commercial purchasing?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide testing samples upon request to assist brands and formulators with technical evaluation.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private-label packaging?
faqs.a: We provide complete OEM and private-label services, including retail pouches, jars, and customized bulk packaging formats.

faqs.q: What packaging options are available for bulk orders?
faqs.a: Bulk orders can be packed in 25 kg bags, robust HDPE containers, or 5-10 kg bags to safeguard against moisture.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom mesh sizes on request?
faqs.a: Yes, we can customize mesh sizes and packaging configurations to match specific manufacturing requirements.

faqs.q: What export support does TradeNest Naturals provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide comprehensive export documentation support to ensure smooth customs clearance and shipping.
